name: car-editor
description: See new paint, rims, wraps, window tint, lowering and body kits on a photo of your own car before you buy or book anything.

interface.shortDescription: Preview mods on your own car
interface.longDescription:
Car Editor shows you what a modification will look like on your own car, using a photo you attach in the chat.

Ask for a mod in plain words, like "put matte black rims on my car" or "how would it look in Nardo Gray?", or open the Car Editor to browse every option with preview images and pick one. Options include paint colors and custom colors, vinyl wraps and carbon fiber, rims with a chosen finish, window tint, lowering, body kits, spoilers, headlights and neon underglow.

Each change builds on the previous result, so you can stack a full build step by step: new color, then rims, then a lower stance. Every render shows a before and after so you can compare. Renders take about 10 to 60 seconds.

Who it is for: car owners deciding on a wrap, paint job or new wheels, enthusiasts planning a build, and anyone curious how their car would look with a different style.

Limitations: results are AI previews for visual inspiration, not exact fitment, offset or color matches, so confirm details with your shop. Works best with a clear side or three-quarter photo of one car. Car Editor does not give legal advice on window tint or modification laws.
capabilities: Change paint color, including any custom color
Apply vinyl wraps and carbon fiber
Swap rims and refinish them in a chosen color
Preview window tint, lowering, body kits, spoilers and lighting
Stack several mods on the same car
Show a before and after for every render
defaultPrompt: Put matte black rims on my car
How would my car look in Nardo Gray?
Open Car Editor and show me mods for my car

positive.description: Browse all mods in the Car Editor card with the user's photo.
positive.prompt: Open Car Editor and show me mods for my car
positive.expected_behavior: The Car Editor card opens with the attached car photo and shows mod categories (paint, rims, wraps, tint, lowering, body kits and more) with preview images. Picking a mod in the card starts a render.

positive.description: Render a named rim change on the attached car photo.
positive.prompt: Put matte black rims on my car
positive.expected_behavior: Within about 10 to 60 seconds a before/after card shows the same car with matte black rims. Body color, background and car shape stay the same.

positive.description: Stack a second mod on the previous render in the same conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Run right after the rim test in the same chat. render_car_mod is called with source_url set to the previous render's continueFromUrl, so the new before/after card keeps the matte black rims and adds a lowered stance.

positive.description: Repaint the car in a named color. Select Car Editor with @ first; without it ChatGPT may answer with its own image generator. In the video this runs in the same chat, so the result keeps the earlier rims and stance.
positive.prompt: @Car Editor paint my car candy red
positive.expected_behavior: A before/after card shows the car repainted candy red. Wheels, background and car shape stay the same.

positive.description: Apply a custom wrap color that is not in the catalog. Select Car Editor with @ first.
positive.prompt: @Car Editor wrap my car in a deep ocean blue
positive.expected_behavior: render_car_mod is called with category customWrap and a custom_color_hex for a deep blue. A before/after card shows the car in a deep blue wrap.

negative.description: General car buying advice with no photo and no request to visualize a mod. Car Editor should not be called; ChatGPT answers on its own.
negative.prompt: Which is more reliable, a 2018 Toyota Camry or a 2018 Honda Accord?

negative.description: Legal question about window tint. Car Editor only previews looks and does not give legal advice, so it should not be called.
negative.prompt: What is the legal window tint percentage in California?

negative.description: Request unrelated to cars. Car Editor should not be called.
negative.prompt: Write a cover letter for a marketing job

publication.release_notes: First public version. Preview paint colors, custom colors, wraps, rims with a chosen finish, window tint, lowering, body kits, spoilers and lighting on a photo of your own car, stack several mods in one conversation, and compare before and after.
